title: Gate Sentry source maps behind a switch, off, so the production compile fits the 8 GB build machine

source.ref: HYG-221 / HYG-231. Production deploy dpl_3oxPk5VW (b44310e, cpus: 1) OOM-killed with next-build at 7.06 GB and the container at 8.05 GB of 8 GB; previews, which build no source maps, peak near 6.8 GB and went READY twice with the same cpus: 1.

detail: MEASURED 2026-11-14 with the HYG-224 sampler. Under Turbopack the Sentry plugin sets productionBrowserSourceMaps = true unless sourcemaps.disable is set (@sentry/nextjs 11.10.0 getFinalConfigObjectBundlerUtils maybeEnableTurbopackSourcemaps), so production builds browser source maps inside the compile; previews had them disabled by HYG-162. The extra is about 0.3 GB at the compile peak, which is the margin between a build that fits and one that is killed. This slice gates them behind SENTRY_SOURCEMAPS (envFlag, blank in .env.example, activation gate in RUNBOOKS) and leaves it off, so production compiles like a preview. COST, flagged: client stack traces in Sentry are minified until the switch is turned back on. Restore path: a production build whose container line shows 1.5 GB of headroom, or producing the maps outside the compile. HYG-221 stays the umbrella and closes on 20 consecutive READY deploys.
